info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Banking Operational Services Internal Bank Account By Internal Bank Account Id-v5-spec
info.description: The Update Internal Bank Account API allows authorized users to modify the details of existing internal bank accounts by specifying the account's unique identifier. This endpoint is essential for financial institutions and operational teams managing banking services to ensure that account information remains accurate and up-to-date. Typical consumers include banking system administrators and financial software applications that require synchronization of account data. By utilizing this API, organizations can efficiently handle changes in account details, improving operational efficiency and compliance.

patch.description: This operation allows you to modify the details of the specified internal bank account identified by ACC-200045. It is important to ensure that all required fields are appropriately filled and validated before submitting the update request.

requestBody.description: This request body allows for the modification of an internal bank account with the specified account number (ACC-200045). It contains the necessary fields to update the account's operational services parameters. Ensure to include only the fields that need to be updated.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the resource is updated.
